LanguageData.VME_Fire_Desired.description:
Flame is an awesome sight to behold.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get moods bonuses depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
LanguageData.VME_Fire_Desired.label: desired
LanguageData.VME_Fire_Despised.description:
There is nothing as dangerous as an out of control fire. Fires should be prevented by any means necessary.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Colonists get negative moods depending on the number of active fires on the map. Campfires, torches, other vanilla fire sources and Stone Campfires from Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Core also count.
LanguageData.VME_Fire_Despised.label: despised
